title: Archora project configuration
description: Per-project tuning for Archora (.archora.json / archora.json). Every field is optional; without a config the analyzer uses built-in defaults.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation. Ignored by the analyzer.

entryPoints.description: Module paths the analyzer treats as graph roots. Reachability and dead-code signals are computed from these. Detected automatically when omitted.

ignore.description: Glob patterns (gitignore-style) excluded from discovery. Use for generated clients, vendored code, or anything you don't want scored.

layerOverrides.description: Map of glob -> layer, forcing the layer classification for matched modules. Valid layers: app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared, core.

dynamicLoaders.description: Custom dynamic-import resolvers, e.g. a loader that maps an argument to a module path.

name.description: Function name that performs the dynamic load (e.g. `loadRemote`).

argIndex.description: Zero-based index of the argument holding the module key. Defaults to 0.

resolveAs.description: Path template; `{0}` is replaced with the literal argument value (e.g. `./mfes/{0}/index`).

contracts.description: Architecture-as-code: boundary rules, per-module budgets and frozen public surfaces. The whole block is opt-in.

boundaries.description: Forbid or whitelist edges crossing module boundaries.

name.description: Stable identifier shown in CLI output and UI grouping.

from.description: Glob matching the importing module ids whose outgoing edges this rule controls.

mode.description: `must-not`: from-modules may NOT import to-modules. `can-only`: from-modules may import ONLY to-modules.

to.description: Glob matching the imported module ids.

except.description: Whitelist globs matched against the importee, applied after the rule predicate.

crossInstance.description: Sibling-isolation knob for `features/*/**` <-> `features/*/**` shapes: only flag edges between different wildcard instances. Defaults to false.

description.description: Free-form text shown in UI tooltips and CLI failure output.

severity.description: Whether a violation fails the check (error) or only reports (warning).

budgets.description: Numeric ceilings on per-module metrics. A rule trips for every matched module that exceeds a bound.

module.description: Glob matching module ids the budget applies to.

maxCycles.description: Maximum cycles touching any matched module.

apiStability.description: Declare public surfaces as frozen or additions-only. Currently stored as intent; the breaking-change diff is computed by the semantic surface check.

module.description: Glob matching the public-surface module ids.

policy.description: `frozen`: no changes. `additions-only`: new exports allowed, removals/changes are not.

analysis.description: Generated-code handling. Build outputs are skipped by discovery regardless of this block.

mode.description: `exclude`: drop generated modules from the graph. `classify`: keep them but mark them so they don't skew findings.

presets.description: Built-in pattern bundles for common generators.

heavyChunkBytes.description: Chunk size in bytes that triggers a `heavy-chunk` signal.

duplicateMinChunks.description: A module appearing in at least this many chunks triggers a `duplicate` signal.

soloHotShare.description: Share (0..1) of a heavy chunk a single module must occupy to trigger a `solo-hot` signal.

signals.description: Signal trust layer: insight limits and persisted suppressions.

suppressions.description: Persisted suppressions for individual signals, written by the app when you dismiss a finding.

insightLimit.description: Maximum number of insights surfaced per scan.

minInsightSeverity.description: Lowest severity an insight must reach to be surfaced.

minInsightConfidence.description: Lowest confidence an insight must reach to be surfaced.

architectureBudget.description: Repository-wide CI gate, used by `archora check`. Limits the current scan or regressions against a base.

maxContractErrors.description: Maximum allowed contract violations at error severity.

maxHotspotGrowth.description: Maximum allowed hot-zone growth against the comparison base.
